title: Two Patrons Satisfied
subtitle: Any two: minRequired: 2
description: Three errands wait on this quest's left and two of them have to be
done, which one does not matter and is the entire point: three
`all_completed` -- decides what 'done' means for each one.
`minRequired` replaces the count, not the bar. `one_started` with
`minRequired: 2` would mean any two of the three merely started,
which is a different sentence and occasionally the right one.
